**Grand Theft Auto: Liberty City Stories Widescreen Fix (PPSSPP)** adds HUD scaling, right-stick controls, a modern control scheme, and optional 60 FPS and game loading speed adjustments.

[Website](https://thirteenag.github.io/wfp#gtalcspsp) · [Source Code](https://github.com/ThirteenAG/WidescreenFixesPack/blob/master/source/GTALCS.PPSSPP.WidescreenFix/main.c) · [Default INI](https://github.com/ThirteenAG/WidescreenFixesPack/blob/master/data/GTALCS.PPSSPP.WidescreenFix/memstick/PSP/PLUGINS/GTALCS.PPSSPP.WidescreenFix/GTALCS.PPSSPP.WidescreenFix.ini)

</div>

---

## Options

- **HUD scale** — Adjust HUD and radar scaling in the INI file.
- **Dual analog controls** — Enable right-stick support.
- **Vehicle controls** — `ModernControlScheme` swaps L/Square and R/Cross in vehicles; swap buttons and triggers in PPSSPP for trigger-based driving.
- **60 FPS** — Optional 60 FPS mode.
- **Loading** — Temporarily unthrottle the emulator during loading screens.
- **Skip intro** — Skip startup intros with `SkipIntro`.

---

## Installation

1. Download the fix archive from this release.
2. Extract the archive into the directory containing PPSSPP’s `memstick` folder, preserving the folders in the archive.
3. Optionally edit `memstick/PSP/PLUGINS/GTALCS.PPSSPP.WidescreenFix/GTALCS.PPSSPP.WidescreenFix.ini` to configure the fix.
4. Launch the game in PPSSPP.

# ImVehLM (Improved Vehicle Lights Mod)

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/4904157/218305955-3a8a244f-aae8-456b-a7ef-dac9d5ca7118.mp4

Installation:
- Download and extract the archive to the directory, where PPSSPP's memory stick is located (File -> Open Memory Stick).
- Inside TEXTURES folder, rename ULUS10041 to the ID, that matches your game (ULUS10041, ULES00151, NPJH50825, ULJM05255, ULJM05359, ULJM05885).
- Enable **Game Settings -> Tools -> Developer Tools -> Replace Textures**.
- Launch the game.
